channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: WPL 2026: Reigning champs Mumbai Indians open account with win over Delhi Capitals
item.description: Nat Sciver-Brunt, Harmanpreet Kaur, and Nicola Carey starred for Mumbai Indians in their 50-run win.

item.title: His game defined, Manav Thakkar now in search of mastery
item.description: With a commendable display at 2026 WTT Champions Doha, Manav Thakkar is on the right track, believes coach Massimo Costantini.

item.title: Three years, multiple injuries, one gold: Hussamuddin returns as National Champion
item.description: After nearly three years of injuries and setbacks, Mohammad Hussamuddin returns to win the men’s 60kg national title in a thrilling final.

item.title: Kashi Kings crowned UPKL Season 2 champions after finals victory over Lucknow Lions
item.description: Kashi Kings delivered a composed all-round performance to defeat Lucknow Lions and lift the Uttar Pradesh Kabaddi League Season 2 trophy in Noida.

item.title: If I can't make 55kg, I'll quit: Jadumani defies family doubts to win national title
item.description: Jadumani Singh switched to the Olympic weight class of 55Kg within a month to pursue his Olympic dream.

item.title: Manush Shah, Ryu Hanna clinch singles titles at WTT Feeder Vadodara
item.description: Manush Shah staged a comeback to win the men’s singles crown, while Ryu Hanna dominated the women’s final and Payas Jain claimed two doubles titles.

item.title: Kalinga Lancers go top after shootout win in Men’s HIL
item.description: Ranchi Royals sealed their first win with a late four-goal surge.

item.title: Wesley So and Carissa Yip clinch Tata Steel Chess India Blitz 2026 titles
item.description: Wesley So sealed the Open title with a round to spare, while Carissa Yip edged Vantika Agrawal in a tense playoff to win the Women’s Blitz crown.

item.title: WPL 2026: Sophie Devine's all-round brilliance powers Gujarat Giants to 2nd straight win
item.description: Giants edged past Delhi Capitals by 4 runs in their second consecutive 400+ run thriller at DY Patil Stadium.

item.title: Tata Steel Chess India Blitz 2026: Nihal Sarin, Vantika Agrawal finish as runners-up
item.description: Vantika lost the tiebreaks after finishing the round-robin at joint top position with Carissa Yip of the USA.
